summary: Focus on high-stakes dramatic conflicts involving major deities (e.g., Shiva vs Yamraj) which drive top view counts.
Target 'Why' questions and everyday ritual origins (e.g., Peepal tree, Gaya Ji Pind Daan) to capture search intent.
Write longer, immersive scripts; videos retaining viewers past 3 minutes achieve peak retention (~38%).
Avoid ultra-short shallow scripts (<40s duration), as retention drops below 10% on rushed storytelling.
Highlight child devotees and extreme tapasya themes (Dhruva, Markandeya) for strong audience engagement.
Use specific curiosity hooks in titles instead of broad generic names like 'Maa Durga Story'.
